input.description:
QC determination by Jaime Salinas (QC Inspector), 2026-07-27: **HOLD — Mesa Vista 4C is NOT marketing-ready and must not be listed.**

Turn under review: June turn — Move-Out 2026-06-15, Target-Ready 2026-06-30 (Airtable Make-Ready Turns record recbd087a4abd605b). Current status: **In Progress**. No valid QC sign-off exists for this turn.

The two scopes that carry this turn are BOTH still open on my rule (a scope billed-but-unfinished, OR finished-but-bill-unpaid, does not count as closed):

1) DEEP CLEAN — Sunshine Cleaning (Carmen Delgado)
   - Work: not signed off. Airtable turn note says deep clean "still tracking on [its] schedule."
   - Vendor: QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C, $387.00 — Balance $387.00 (UNPAID / open).
   - => NOT CLOSED.

2) INTERIOR REPAINT — Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan)
   - Work: not signed off. Airtable turn note says interior repaint "still tracking on [its] schedule."
   - Vendor: QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09, $1,340.00 — Balance $1,340.00 (UNPAID / open).
   - => NOT CLOSED.

Additional 4C bills also still outstanding (unpaid) in QuickBooks:
   - 2026-519, Permian Make-Ready Crew, $85.00 — closet-trim touch-up.
   - 2026-481-566, Alamo HVAC Services, $85.00 — turnover condition inspection / punch-list documentation.

Re-inspection: a re-inspection is scheduled for mid-July and has not yet occurred. A pending re-inspection means the turn is not cleared.

On the "wrapped / market-ready" claim: ticket MR-4C-2026-08 (and a duplicate make-ready record marked Ready) state the unit passed a QC walkthrough "by Jaime" and re-inspection and that Brooke was cleared to list. That claim is NOT valid — I never performed or signed off a QC pass on this June turn, and the record carries an impossible completion date of 2026-05-01 (before the 2026-06-15 move-out). Disregard it.

WHAT MUST HAPPEN BEFORE THIS UNIT CAN BE RELEASED FOR LISTING:
   [ ] Deep clean completed and signed off; bill 2026-SC-4C paid/reconciled in QuickBooks.
   [ ] Interior repaint completed and signed off; bill PD-2026-09 paid/reconciled in QuickBooks.
   [ ] Punch/closet-trim bill 2026-519 and inspection bill 2026-481-566 reconciled.
   [ ] Mid-July re-inspection performed and PASSED by QC (Jaime Salinas).
   [ ] Make-Ready Turns status advanced to Ready only after all of the above.

Until every item above is closed and I have re-inspected, this unit stays In Progress and does NOT go to marketing. Ownership pass-through (Pete Donovan owner account) also depends on these bills being finalized.

input.subject: Mesa Vista 4C — QC hold, not releasing for listing yet
input.body:
Carlos,

I know you have Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and want it released for listing, and Brooke is ready to market it on your word. I ran my own QC pass against the source systems before signing off, and I can't clear it yet. I'm holding it. Here's exactly where it stands.

Turn under review: June turn — moved out 6/15, target-ready 6/30 (Airtable Make-Ready record). Airtable status is still In Progress, and there is no valid QC sign-off on this turn.

The two scopes that carry this turn are both still open. My rule: a scope that's billed but unfinished, or finished with the bill still unpaid, does not count as closed.

1) Deep clean — Sunshine Cleaning
   - Not signed off; the make-ready record still shows the deep clean "tracking on its schedule."
   - QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C for $387.00 is still unpaid (full balance open).

2) Interior repaint — Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan)
   - Not signed off; the make-ready record still shows the repaint "tracking on its schedule."
   - QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09 for $1,340.00 is still unpaid (full balance open).

Two more 4C bills are also open/unpaid and need to be reconciled as part of closing this out:
   - 2026-519 (Permian) $85.00 — closet-trim touch-up.
   - 2026-481-566 (Alamo HVAC) $85.00 — turnover condition inspection / punch-list documentation.

One more thing: the "market-ready / QC-passed" note on this unit (ticket MR-4C-2026-08) isn't something I can rely on. It credits a QC walkthrough and re-inspection to me that I never performed on this turn, and it's dated 2026-05-01 — before the unit moved out on 6/15. I'm disregarding it.

There's also a re-inspection on the calendar for the middle of this month that hasn't happened yet. Until it does and passes, the turn isn't cleared.

What I need before 4C can go to listing:
   - Deep clean completed and signed off; bill 2026-SC-4C paid/reconciled.
   - Interior repaint completed and signed off; bill PD-2026-09 paid/reconciled.
   - Closet-trim bill 2026-519 and inspection bill 2026-481-566 reconciled.
   - Mid-month re-inspection performed and passed by me.

I've opened Linear OPS-1000 with the full detail and checklist and assigned it to you so we can track it to closure. I've also flagged the hold in #make-ready so Brooke doesn't market it in the meantime. Once the scopes are closed and the bills are squared, I'll re-walk it right after the re-inspection and clear it if it holds up.

Thanks,
Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector, Star Property Management

## The call: HOLD. Mesa Vista 4C is NOT marketing-ready. Do not list.

Carlos has it down as wrapped, but that doesn't survive contact with the data. The turn he's describing — moved out mid-June (6/15), target-ready end of month (6/30) — is Airtable record `recbd087a4abd605b`, and it's still **In Progress**. Both carrying scopes are open, and the vendor side is not reconciled:

| Scope | Work signed off? | Vendor bill | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Deep clean** (Sunshine Cleaning) | No — "still tracking" in the turn record | QB `2026-SC-4C` $387 | **UNPAID** (balance $387) |
| **Interior repaint** (Permian Make-Ready Crew) | No — "still tracking" in the turn record | QB `PD-2026-09` $1,340 | **UNPAID** (balance $1,340) |

Two more 4C bills are also open/unpaid: closet-trim touch-up `2026-519` ($85) and turnover inspection `2026-481-566` ($85). Neither scope meets my bar — billed-but-unfinished, and finished-or-not, the bills are still sitting there.

**On the "wrapped" claim:** ticket `MR-4C-2026-08` (and a duplicate make-ready record marked Ready) says the unit passed a QC walkthrough "by Jaime" and re-inspection and that Brooke was cleared to list. That's not real — I never ran or signed off a QC pass on this turn, and the record is dated **2026-05-01, before the unit even moved out on 6/15**. I disregarded it. The "market-ready" Slack chatter Carlos posted traces to May 22, not this June turn.

**Re-inspection:** the mid-July re-inspection hasn't happened yet — not on my calendar, and a pending re-inspection means the turn isn't cleared regardless.

## What I did
- **Airtable** — recorded the QC HOLD determination on the June-turn record; left status at **In Progress** (did not advance to Ready).
- **Linear OPS-1000** — opened, assigned to Carlos, spelling out exactly what's left (both scopes completed + signed off + bills paid, the two smaller bills reconciled, and my re-inspection passed) as a checklist. https://linear.app/synthetic/issue/OPS-1000
- **#make-ready** — posted the HOLD, tagging Brooke and Carlos so Brooke hears it from us and holds listing before she markets it.
- **Email to Carlos (cc Brooke)** — drafted with the full specifics, in your Gmail drafts for you to review and send.

It goes to listing only after every outstanding scope is completed, signed off, and its bill reconciled — and after I re-walk it following the mid-month re-inspection.
